title: WD-001 phase-A selection lock: submit selected.json before any ImageNetV2 run
description: Procedural sub-task of WD-001. (Replaces ledger entry WD-001A, never claimed: its write paths overlapped WD-001 and the harness refused the claim; WD-001A stays pending with no work and should be ignored.) WD-001's acceptance requires selected.json to be submitted before the first phase-B (ImageNetV2) run, but submitting WD-001 itself would move the whole task to review before phase B exists. This task hash-locks byte-identical copies of the phase-A outputs (in ai_harness/artifacts/WD-001S; the harness refuses write paths that overlap WD-001, and run_wdcheck.py reads ai_harness/artifacts/WD-001/selected.json, whose sha256 must equal this copy): selected.json, analysis_val.md, analysis_val.json (all generated by analyze_val.py from the 144 validation-only runs) and analyze_val.py itself (written 2026-11-27T07:53Z before any phase-A result was read). Phase B must not start until this submit is recorded. Review: check that the selection in selected.json follows the pre-registered rule in WD-001's task.json from the phase-A done.json files (no test data), that the flags are reported correctly, and that the submit time precedes the first [wd-test] line in runs/WD-001/test_log.txt. May be reviewed together with WD-001.
acceptance: Submitted before the first phase-B run
